title: Find a focused reference reading list
description: A phrase-only reading-list run across history, public policy, and economics research with parallel batched verification and resumable checkpoints.

diagrams.title: Find a focused reference reading list
diagrams.description: Captions move through phrase curation, timeline balancing, parallel batched verification, and a portable reading list.
diagrams.accessibility: Start with a YouTube video, read captions from the optional timestamp, find meaningful references, remove repeats and balance the timeline, verify sources in parallel batches, optionally add one short discussion-context paragraph, and show a reading list with thumbnails and Markdown export. If a limit is reached, resume in-place from the saved checkpoint without losing results.
